name: Campingplatz Fohnsee
beschreibung: The Fohnsee campsite is located in Eben am Achensee, directly on the shore of the Fohnsee. The surroundings are characterized by dense forests and the imposing mountain backdrop of the Karwendelgebirge. The facilities include simple but well-maintained pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents, as well as modern sanitary facilities. The quiet, close-to-nature atmosphere makes the site an ideal retreat for those seeking relaxation. The target group is primarily nature lovers, hikers, and mountain bikers who appreciate the untouched landscape. The nearby Achensee and the nature reserve offer a variety of leisure activities such as swimming, fishing, and hiking. The Fohnsee campsite thus appeals to guests looking for an authentic camping holiday in the Tiroler Bergwelt.
